newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells stake in veterinary practice.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells stake in veterinary practice.

text.p: Croatia's state privatisation agency, the Croatian Privatisation Fund, sold its minority interest in a small veterinary practice, the Zagreb Stock Exchange said on Monday.
A 22.86 percent in Veterinarska Stanica Klanjec was sold for a nominal 43,667 German marks to Investco brokers at an auction for public debt notes.
Payment in these notes includes a discount of up to 30 percent on the face value of equity.

The fund also holds cash auctions for the remaining government assets in mostly privatised firms on the bourse each Thursday. But investor interest has diminished since the most attractive firms were sold.
